title: Bump lore to 0.12.0 on dev for the lore/quest pair release (bump only: no publish, no promote, no tag)
description:
Dispatched by opum-agent (cross-session, 2026-09-29): the OPAG-761 pair release. All three prerequisites are reported landed — opum-cli-e2e's --across-refs rows (TASK-141), this repository's LCLI-544 lockfile-pin gate at 10274f64 (#431), quest-cli's QCLI-419 on its dev — and lore and quest share one version under constitution Article 3, so both move to 0.12.0 together. npm has 0.11.0 on latest for both @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest, and --across-refs is a new feature, so the shared number is 0.12.0, unpublished for both at dispatch time. quest-cli's mirror bump is opum-ai/quest-cli#443 (chore(QCLI-421)), opened 2026-09-29T17:21:04Z.

SCOPE, verbatim from the dispatch: bump every version site to 0.12.0, PR into dev, land it, report the PR, dev's SHA by ref, the site count, and whether a source build's lore --version prints 0.12.0. Do NOT publish, stage an RC, tag or promote — the orchestrator calls the release candidate once both packages are at 0.12.0 on dev.

A BLOCKER THE DISPATCH'S ORDERING CANNOT CROSS, measured rather than inferred (see implementation notes): the docs gate and compile smoke are two of the six required contexts on dev, and both drive quest through lore's runtime pair lock (LCLI-650), which refuses any quest that is not exactly lore's package.json version. So a lore at 0.12.0 cannot go green until quest 0.12.0 is on npm, and the bump commit must also move the version CLAUDE.md's managed Quest block declares — which cannot be regenerated before quest 0.12.0 is installable. release-publishing.md's bump step states this prerequisite in its own words. Recorded here so the blocker survives the session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every version site in the tracked tree reads 0.12.0 — root package.json version plus its six optionalDependencies pins, the six npm/<platform>/package.json manifests, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and bun.lock six pins — with the git grep inventory recorded as found vs changed, and bun run check:lockfile-pins and bun run check:packages each exit 0
bun run src/cli.ts --version prints 0.12.0 from a source build, and the README two lore-version regions are regenerated so node scripts/shipped-readme-version.mjs --check exits 0

The three version-bearing Ladybug digest baselines are refreshed under the runbook two controls — only canonicalExportSha256 moved in each fixture, and reverting just the root package.json version to 0.11.0 makes the old baselines pass again — with the fixture and report suites green
CHANGELOG Unreleased entries sit under a dated [0.12.0] heading, bun run check:breaking-bump -- --next 0.12.0 exits 0, and bun test is green

The bump lands on dev by squash-merge only with all six required contexts green on the PR head SHA, and the quest-0.12.0-on-npm prerequisite is recorded on this record rather than worked around by landing red

plan: 1. Branch from origin/dev for the 0.12.0 bump
2. Bump the manifest version sites: root package.json version + six optionalDependencies pins, six npm/<platform> manifests, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, then regenerate bun.lock with the pinned Bun
3. Regenerate the README lore-version regions with scripts/shipped-readme-version.mjs --write
4. Fold CHANGELOG [Unreleased] under a dated [0.12.0] heading; run check:breaking-bump --next 0.12.0
5. Refresh the three Ladybug digest baselines from the failing fixture test, with the two runbook controls (only canonicalExportSha256 moved; revert sole version to 0.11.0 and the old baselines pass)
6. Update tests that pin real repo state, run bun test + lint + typecheck + check:lockfile-pins + check:packages + shipped-readme-version --check locally
7. Push, open the PR into dev, run the required checks; land by squash-merge only if green
8. Record the quest-0.12.0-on-npm prerequisite; report PR, dev SHA by ref, site count, and source-build --version to opum-agent
implementationNotes: BUMP APPLIED on branch chore/LCLI-653-bump-0.12.0 (not yet landed). SITES: git grep -c '0\.11\.0' origin/dev reports 140 occurrences in 73 tracked files including .quest, 103 in 36 excluding it; of those exactly 20 are live version values and all 20 moved — root package.json version + six optionalDependencies pins (7), the six npm/<platform>/package.json manifests (6), .claude-plugin/plugin.json (1), bun.lock six platform pins (6). Every other 0.11.0 occurrence is history, a comment example, sample test data or a fixture and was left alone; the ten files that lost their 0.11.0 mention are exactly plugin.json, bun.lock, the six npm manifests, package.json and README.md. GATES, all with pinned Bun 1.4.2 (/opt/homebrew/bin/bun; PATH bun here is 1.3.14): check:lockfile-pins exit 0 (six pins compared, all at 0.12.0), check:packages exit 0, bun install --frozen-lockfile exit 0, shipped-readme-version --write and --check exit 0, check:breaking-bump -- --next 0.12.0 exit 0 (quest-cli dev reads ## 0.12.0, no breaking heading), lint exit 0, typecheck exit 0, lint:shell exit 0, bun run src/cli.ts --version and dist/lore --version both print 0.12.0. DERIVED ARTIFACTS refreshed per release-publishing.md: the two README lore-version regions, CHANGELOG folded so [Unreleased] is empty and the entries sit under '## [0.12.0] - 2026-09-29', and the three Ladybug digest baselines (small 092a703b…, large e8272e39…, report 22f3c363…). Both digest controls ran: only canonicalExportSha256 moved in each fixture, and reverting only root package.json's version to 0.11.0 with the OLD baselines returned 3 pass / 0 fail. test/lcli632-breaking-bump-gate.test.ts's real-tree block now pins the new state; its refusal direction still comes from the synthetic fixtures. BLOCKER, MEASURED (not inferred): with lore 0.12.0 (source and compiled) and quest 0.11.0 on PATH — npm latest for both — bun run lore check exits 6, 'the lore 0.12.0 / quest 0.11.0 pair version requirement is not met' (LCLI-650 lock, src/adapters/quest.ts:408), and scripts/readme-quickstart.sh dist/lore exits 6 at lore link, the exact step compile smoke runs. So two of dev's six required contexts cannot go green until quest 0.12.0 is on npm: lore check (docs gate) and compile smoke (ubuntu). Ruleset require-ci-on-dev is enforcement=active with bypass=[] , so the PR cannot land red. release-publishing.md's bump step states the prerequisite in its own words. Remaining step for the landed commit, once quest 0.12.0 is installable: quest agents --update-instructions --target claude, which moves CLAUDE.md's declared version by regeneration (never a hand edit). quest-cli's mirror bump merged to its dev 2026-09-29T17:32:49Z (opum-ai/quest-cli#443); npm still reads 0.11.0 latest for both packages.

PR opened: opum-ai/lore-cli#433, DRAFT on purpose, base dev, head chore/LCLI-653-bump-0.12.0 (commit a2a06ad2). It is a draft because it cannot land: two required contexts are red until @opum-ai/quest@0.12.0 resolves from npm, and require-ci-on-dev has no bypass actors. Landing it anyway would also leave dev un-landable for every later PR, since the docs gate and compile smoke run lore from the PR's own source at 0.12.0 against whatever quest CLAUDE.md declares.

FULL SUITE on the bumped tree (pinned Bun 1.4.2, after the lcli632 re-pin): 4878 pass, 1 skip, 3 fail out of 4882 across 138 files. All three failures are the LCLI-614 real-quest rows in test/link-quest-race.test.ts, and they fail on the same pair lock (quest.version-pair-mismatch, lore 0.12.0 vs quest 0.11.0). That file skips itself when no quest is on PATH and ci.yml installs quest in only three jobs (Tracker integrity, docs gate, compile smoke), so the lint·typecheck·test job's suite is green by construction; the three reds are a workstation consequence of running the bump before quest 0.12.0 exists, and they clear when the local quest is 0.12.0.

PR #433's own CI reproduces the blocker on the exact head SHA a2a06ad2 (run 36606300734, opened 2026-09-29T17:37Z): the 'lore check (docs gate)' job 109536085814 logs 'Declared Quest version: 0.11.0' then 'error: the lore 0.12.0 / quest 0.11.0 pair version requirement is not met' — after printing '82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings', so the bundle itself is clean and the refusal is purely the lock; the 'compile smoke (ubuntu)' job 109536085540 passes its binary assertion ('lore --version => 0.12.0 (package.json: 0.12.0)') and fails at the quickstart with the same error. Green on the same head: Tracker integrity, platform package set and lockfile pins (the LCLI-544 gate), config test (newest Bun), ladybug benchmark smoke (the refreshed digests), mkdocs scaffold smoke. NOTE: this note was re-issued to replace a first version whose backticked job names were eaten by the shell before the tracker saw them.
